blocks.heading: Amazon Ecosystem LLM Applications
paragraphs: For Amazon's seller community, AWS partners, and the technology companies building on AWS:

Amazon seller intelligence: Claude 3.5 Sonnet via AWS Bedrock integrated over Amazon seller documentation, marketplace guidelines, and product catalog — enabling large Amazon sellers to query policy requirements and listing optimization guidance in natural language.

AWS infrastructure intelligence: GPT-4o integrated over AWS documentation, CloudFormation templates, and architecture best practices for Seattle's large AWS-native technology companies — enabling engineers to ask natural language questions about AWS service capabilities, pricing, and architectural trade-offs.

Customer service intelligence: LLM applications for Seattle's eCommerce companies handling customer inquiries — RAG over product catalogs, return policies, and FAQ databases for intelligent customer service automation.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | AWS-native architecture

blocks.heading: Microsoft Azure OpenAI Applications
paragraphs: For Microsoft (Redmond, adjacent Seattle) and Microsoft's large enterprise customer ecosystem:

Enterprise knowledge assistants: GPT-4o via Azure OpenAI for Seattle's Microsoft-standardized enterprises — integrating with SharePoint, Teams, and Azure Active Directory for enterprise AI assistants that respect existing access controls.
Technical documentation intelligence: Azure OpenAI RAG over Microsoft's large documentation corpora for Microsoft's own product teams and the ISV community building on Microsoft platforms.
GitHub Copilot ecosystem extensions: Custom LLM applications extending Microsoft's Copilot ecosystem for Seattle's software development community.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | Azure tenant integration

blocks.heading: Aerospace Technical Documentation LLM
paragraphs: For Boeing, Blue Origin, and Seattle's aerospace manufacturing community:

Technical documentation Q&A: Self-hosted Llama 3 deployed on Boeing's internal cloud infrastructure — processing maintenance manuals, engineering specifications, and quality documents to answer technician questions without any aerospace IP leaving Boeing's network.
Engineering change assistance: LLM helping Boeing engineering teams understand the scope and impact of engineering changes from natural language descriptions of modifications.

Supplier communication intelligence: LLM for Boeing's supplier qualification and communication — enabling procurement teams to query supplier capabilities and quality history across large supplier databases.
Cost: $30,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | Self-hosted, IP protection

blocks.heading: Healthcare Clinical LLM Applications
paragraphs: For UW Medicine and Providence Health:

Clinical documentation assistance: Claude 3.5 Sonnet via AWS Bedrock (HIPAA BAA available) for ambient documentation at Seattle's health systems — superior instruction-following for structured clinical note generation from physician dictation.
Clinical protocol Q&A: LLM integrated over UW Medicine's clinical guidelines and formulary for point-of-care clinical staff query.

Washington MHMD-compliant health AI: LLM applications for Washington's consumer health data must comply with WA MHMD Act — ClickMasters designs Seattle health LLM applications with WA MHMD Act consent and data handling requirements.
Cost: $30,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | HIPAA + WA MHMD Act
